name: 12T

Network.SIM: 12T/Redmi K50 Ultra: Dual SIM (Nano-SIM), 12T Pro: Dual SIM (Nano-SIM + eSIM and Nano-SIM + Nano-SIM)

Body.Other: Fingerprint scanner (under display, optical), virtual proximity sensor, accelerometer, gyroscope, compass, color temperature sensor.

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 12 + MIUI 13, Current: Android 15 + Xiaomi HyperOS 3
Platform.Chipset: 12T: MediaTek MT6893 Dimensity 8100-Ultra (5 nm), 12T Pro/Redmi K50 Ultra: Qualcomm SM8475 Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1 (4 nm)
Platform.CPU: 8 cores (4×2.85 GHz Cortex-A78 & 4×2 GHz Cortex-A55), 12T Pro/Redmi K50 Ultra: 8 cores (1×3.19 GHz Cortex-X2 & 3×2.75 GHz Cortex-A710 & 4×2 GHz Cortex-A510)
Platform.GPU: 12T: Mali-G610 MC6, 12T Pro/Redmi K50 Ultra: Adreno 730

Memory.RAM: 12T: 8 GB, 12T Pro/Redmi K50 Ultra: 8/12 GB, LPDDR5

Cameras.Rear camera: Wide:, 12T: 108 MP Samsung S5KHM6, 26 mm (wide-angle), 1/1.52", 0.7 μm, PDAF, OIS, 12T Pro: 200 MP Samsung S5KHP1, 26 mm (wide-angle), 1/1.12", 0.64 μm, PDAF, OIS, Redmi K50 Ultra: 108 MP Samsung S5KHM6, 26 mm (wide-angle), 1/1.52", 0.7 μm, PDAF, OIS, Ultrawide: 8 MP, 120˚, 1/4", 1.12 μm, Macro: 2 MP, Dual-LED dual-tone flash, HDR, panorama, Video: 8K@30fps (12T Pro), 4K@30/60 (except 12T) fps, 1080p@30/60/120/240/960fps, HDR10+, gyro-EIS

Battery.Charging: 120 W fast charging, 100% in 17 min (advertised), Power Delivery 3.0

Connectivity.Connectivity: USB-C 2.0, Bluetooth 5.2 (12T Pro/Redmi K50 Ultra)/5.3 (12T) (A2DP, LE, aptX HD, aptX Adaptive), NFC, IR port, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/6 (dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot), GPS (L1 + L5), GLONASS (L1), Galileo (E1 + E5a), BeiDou (B1l + B1c + B2a), QZSS (L1 + L5), NavIC (L5)
